summary: Malformed UTF-8/encoding handling in XML_GetBuffer path leads to memory corruption / potential RCE.
requires: attacker-controlled XML document fed to the parser
notes: Memory-safety violation parsing attacker XML; core supported path.

summary: Integer overflow in storeRawNames() leading to out-of-bounds write.
notes: OOB write on attacker input; violates memory-safety property.

summary: Internal entity expansion amplifies beyond expat's default billion-laughs cap, exhausting memory/CPU.
requires: attacker XML with nested entities, parser at default settings (>=2.4.0)
notes: Modern expat provides amplification protection by default, making the cap a claimed property. Contested: for pre-2.4.0 or if maintainer treats the cap as best-effort, this is BY-DESIGN. Ratify against the pinned version.

summary: Entity-expansion DoS after the application lowered/disabled the amplification protection.
requires: app calls XML_SetBillionLaughsAttackProtection* to weaken the default
notes: Only reachable after the caller weakens a protective default (§1.6). Contested vs downstream-responsibility framing (§1.13).

summary: XML external entity (XXE) resolution leaks local files when the app installs an external-entity handler.
requires: application opts into external entity resolution
notes: Expat does not resolve external entities unless the app opts in; XXE defense is the caller's responsibility (§1.12/§1.13). Contested vs OUT-OF-MODEL: non-default-build.
